messages:
jamal: quick heads-up — i'm proposing a 60-day deprecation window for v1 default routing. plan: emit deprecation header + console badge + opt-in shadowing. thoughts?

sara: 60 days ok for tenants we own. worried about telemetry noise if we flip badge on orgs all at once :grimacing:

alex: we should sample progressively. suggestion: 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 3 weeks. tie to metric: v1->v2 error delta. if delta > 0.5% pause rollout.

jamal: yes tie to delta. also need graceful fallthrough: header-based routing wins, else token-affinity, else console toggle.

mel: console UX concern: how do we show 'beta/legacy' in Usage dashboard? we should avoid breaking billing charts. maybe separate breakdown by api_version tag.

jamal: agreed. telemetry team: will adding api_version tag to traces be heavy? @deploy-bot can we instrument header extraction at ingress?

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: api-version-tagging job will run in prod on next deploy window. will add trace tag for requests with `x-redwood-api-version`.

toa: regarding quota mapping, if v1 had per-tenant legacy quotas, do we map 1->1 to v2 quotas or treat requests as 'compat' and bill at v2 rates? billing needs policy.

sara: billing: prefer map 1->1 for grace period, but show meter as 'legacy-unified' to avoid user surprise. after grace end, automatic remap with email notice.

alex: need a migration probe endpoint: `POST /v2/migration/probe` that validates payload compat. allow clients to opt-in and get report of incompatibilities.

mel: Console UX: add a 'migration report' card per token showing incompatibilities and sample prompts that fail. low-priority but high value.

jamal: runbook: if error delta > threshold, rollback: stop badge, revert sampling, send tenant owners email. also open a jira with priority P1 for repeated regressions.

alex: small nit: header parity check in proxy should normalize `x-redwood-api-version: \"v1\"` and `1`. support both legacy forms.

jamal: include code snippet for routing heuristics:

```
# proxy routing pseudo:
version = req.headers.get("x-redwood-api-version") or token.meta.get("preferred_version")
if version == "1":
    route_to("v1-compat-pool")
elif version == "2":
    route_to("v2-pool")
else:
    # fallback: token affinity then cost-based
    if token.affinity == "v2":
        route_to("v2-pool")
    else:
        route_to("compat-pool")
```

mel: +1 to affinity fallback. Also add telemetry event 'deprec.banner_shown' and 'deprec.accepted' to track UX.

toa: quota enforcement: during sampling, count tokens against v2 quotas but label them `compat-sampled` for accounting. reconciled at grace end.

sara: any objections to 60 days? if not I'll lock the rollout plan and notify legal/compliance for record.

alex: no objections from infra side. just want a probe-flag in console to manually pause per-tenant rollouts.

jamal: ok locking: 60d window, progressive sampling 5/20/100, delta threshold 0.5% errors, token-tagging enabled, console badges + migration report, billing map 1->1 during window, automatic remap at end with notice.

jamal: tl;dr: I'll open rollout PR and the runbook. ping me if you want to be on the cadence.

mel: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: audit: rollout-pr created #PR-4821; deploy job queued.
